text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nikkeiiii Shinshun Haiii! Let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first race of the senior year is the Nikkei Shinshun Hai, and Mejiro Palmer is extremely pumped.
choice_data_list: What's got into you all of a sudden?
What's got into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nothing! I just thought I should treat this whole day like a party!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Especially considering how, let's say… half-hearted I was last year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You know, with the whole freaking out midway and just letting things play out thing. So…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm bringin' it today! I'm gonna be in everyone's face right out the gate! That's how I do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the first graded race of the year, and Mejiro Palmer seems ready to wager everything on her brand-new image.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Time to hit the paddock and do this thing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's go, bestie! Waheeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey, Palmster! ☆ Just follow the plan and you'll definitely slay this race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Daitaku Helios is already picking up on it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer is in the paddock, and it's finally time to really get the party started.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mejirooo! Waheeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I-I guess they're a bit surprised. Fair enough. This is probably the first time any Mejiro Umamusume has introduced themselves with "Mejirooo! Waheeey!")

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (But that doesn't matter. I'm gonna do things my way!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's good, everyone?! Are you ready to party?! Or are ya out there, snoozin'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If you're snoozin', you'd better wake up 'cause this race is gonna melt your face! Don't doubt the power of the wahey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Who needs another snoozefest of a race?! Not me! Forget boring, lame performances!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna ramp the energy here up to eleven straight out the gate, so I wanna hear you makin' some noooise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do this thing! This Mejiro's gonna slaaay! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A faint cheer follows her introduction. Half of the spectators appear stunned. Even so…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Eh, that's good enough for now. Not everyone's on board yet…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I'm just getting started! They'll be right there with me once I start slayin'! Just you watch, Trainer!
